theorems.statement: ∀ {k G X Y ι : Type} [Field k] [Group G] [MulAction G X] [MulAction G Y] [Fintype ι] (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N), (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∀ (t : ι → G) (F : X → A) (Q : Y → B), ((∀ (s : G) (x : X), F (s • x) = A.ρ s (F x)) → ∀ (x : X) (y : Y), (∑ c : ι, N.ρ (t c) (φ (F ((t c)⁻¹ • x)) (Q ((t c)⁻¹ • y)))) = φ (F x) (∑ c : ι, B.ρ (t c) (Q ((t c)⁻¹ • y)))) ∧ ((∀ (s : G) (y : Y), Q (s • y) = B.ρ s (Q y)) → ∀ (x : X) (y : Y), (∑ c : ι, N.ρ (t c) (φ (F ((t c)⁻¹ • x)) (Q ((t c)⁻¹ • y)))) = φ (∑ c : ι, A.ρ (t c) (F ((t c)⁻¹ • x))) (Q y))
